lead_assessments.assessment: The exact STRling line 60 names the PCRE2 C API and pins 10.47. The publisher tag, release commit, README and native API manual independently reproduced the identifying description. This links the documented interface language to the existing C language entity. The IEC representation still differs from its enrolled digest. WG14 N3220 and N3221 identify the C subject and post-C23 working-draft scope separately. The link concerns the native interface language only.

challenge.method: Independently reacquire original GitHub anchor and pinned raw Git blob. Compare entire embedded line array. Resolve the publisher release-list link, non-prerelease tag and annotated tag object, then verify README and manual Git blob identifiers from the exact commit/doc tree. Review the man-page native interface material against the README distinction between native and POSIX APIs and pattern syntax. Render and inspect the N3220 cover and §1 and compare with N3221 draft-status labels and the live IEC product title/edition.
challenge.results: The STRling row refers to a standalone regex library interface and carries a fixed 10.47 planning representative. The documented native API is a C interface. The library, POSIX wrapper and pattern notation have separate scopes. Seven GitHub web response envelopes changed while the controlling row, tag object/commit identifiers and Git blobs matched. N3220 remains a C2y working draft even though its cover bears an ISO/IEC 9899:2024 header, and N3221 distinguishes N3219 and the post-C23 draft. The IEC catalog still names C and the fifth published edition, while the registered catalog response could not be reproduced.

limitations: The suggested ledger disposition classifies the exact origin’s interface-language referent. The existing C identity reference is used under the frozen qualified selection.
Conformance to ISO/IEC 9899:2024 or another C edition, ABI, PCRE pattern semantics, installed build behavior and current or historical width/matcher coverage remain outside this finding.
The IEC source needs its own exact-representation revalidation. The live page and the WG14 draft and editor report do not requalify it.
The GitHub tag response reports unknown_key. Publisher release, annotated tag destination and exact Git payloads were inspected. Independent cryptographic tag authentication remains open.
The historical unresolved candidate is preserved at the supplied revision. The proposed successor is a discovery-only projection.
